summary: ASSA ABLOY Entrance Systems Nederland. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: ASSA ABLOY's Veldhoven unit works on secure document issuance (passports, ID cards) for governments in over 100 countries; one senior compliance role open, no Dutch needed.

culture.text: The Secure Document Issuance unit builds hardware, software and services for issuing passports, ID cards and driving licences, operating mainly from the Netherlands and Italy.
Postings describe a global team with flexible work, and openness to job sharing and part-time arrangements.

open.text: It is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Postings encourage you to apply even if you meet most, not all, of the requirements.
